scope: Four source-behavior controls, not a personal monetary backtest

common.NonTradePeriods: All seven weekdays allowed, all 40 exclusion intervals disabled

data.selection: All available H1 bars of the named series, including available warmup; no active-window filter and no stitching
data.publication_timestamp: NOT_OBSERVED; begin+60min is the nominal earliest completed-H1 boundary, not a measured API delivery time

execution.engine: Original OsEngine TesterServer, native candle mode
execution.commission: None in source-behavior control; not an assertion of zero real fees
execution.terminal_position: Keep unresolved; do not force liquidation
execution.native_candle_path: Synthetic O,H,L,C all stamped TimeStart; native timestamps retained separately from information-availability time

platform_position_support_overrides.reason: No platform-added protection or repeated exits in this source-behavior control. Platform defaults DoubleExit and 50-second order timers differ; initial/effective settings retained. Source robot rules are unchanged.

instrumentation: Generated derived Custom classes observe events after the unchanged source handler; no changes to trading rules, indicators, or execution engine. Original source hashes retained; generated platform copies are not published.
checks: Native compilation and actual tester execution
All observed bars accounted for; On and schedule explicitly checked
All native indicators compared with independent formulas
At least first three available entry/exit events traced to raw candles; fewer disclosed
known_before_run: Local git download DNS failure; native SDK absent locally
Independent source audit identifies nonstandard RSI initialization and zero-loss/gain behavior
Native economic/security defaults are not historical Sber economics
forbidden: Claiming profit from this technical control
